context_policy: Full transcript plus 64 output positions must fit min(model max_position_embeddings, tokenizer model_max_length); registration fails otherwise, no exclusion or truncation.
device: CPU float32, two Torch threads, sequential fresh workers

mechanisms.recent: whole-turn chronological eviction to 512 native prompt tokens
mechanisms.lexical: unchanged lexical-v1 then same whole-turn fit
mechanisms.toruk: unchanged recurrent/cosine selector with m6-successor-v1 checkpoint then same whole-turn fit

primary_metric: case-balanced frozen answer accuracy; 28 cases, four per category

cost_policy.primary: development including replay + heldout cold workers; TORUK also pays original profile/training CPU and wall once, amortized over 28 heldout queries
cost_policy.units: CPU seconds, wall seconds and separate BPE/selector-byte work counters; no token-equivalence or FLOPs claim

rules: New synthetic records; no heldout answers examined before freeze
No mechanism or scoring change after registration; development is technical validation only
Development first-case replay charged but not scored twice
Heldout once per arm, failed attempts retained, no favorable retry
Identical explicit qualified system instruction, Reference/Question/Answer envelope, native chat template, questions and 64-token answer cap across arms
No hidden labels or required-evidence metadata passed to model or selectors
Historical M6 remains NOT REPRODUCIBLE; successor and backbone evidence unchanged
